225	// series refs. Compaction callers only request AllPostings, which is served from the
226	// precomputed ref list without re-reading the Head. Other IndexReader methods delegate to
227	// the caller-supplied filter, which encodes the compaction flow's notion of "matching series".
228	type headSelectedSeriesIndexReader struct {
229		*headIndexReader
230		selectedSeriesRefs seriesRefs
231	}
232	
233	type allSelectedSeriesPostings struct{ index.Postings }
234	
235	func (h *headSelectedSeriesIndexReader) Postings(ctx context.Context, name string, values ...string) (index.Postings, error) {
236		if len(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef) == 0 {
237			return index.EmptyPostings(), nil
238		}
239	
240		selectedSeriesPostings := index.NewListPostings(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef)
241		// This method is only expected to be called during compaction from the AllSortedPostings, with AllPostingsKey.
242		// The result of this method will be passed to SortedPostings().
243		// In order to avoid sorting head twice, but still return the correct results, we return a postings type with a marker here.
244		// This marker will be used by SortedPostings to swap the full postings by the ones sorted by labels.
245		// However, the results is still valid to be used as normal postings as well.
246		if k, v := index.AllPostingsKey(); name == k && len(values) == 1 && values[0] == v {
247			return allSelectedSeriesPostings{selectedSeriesPostings}, nil
248		}
249	
250		// This is not expected to be used, as headSelectedSeriesIndexReader is only expected to be used during compaction.
251		return index.Intersect(selectedSeriesPostings, h.head.postings.Postings(ctx, name, values...)), nil
252	}
253	
254	func (h *headSelectedSeriesIndexReader) PostingsForLabelMatching(ctx context.Context, name string, match func(string) bool) index.Postings {
255		// This is not expected to be used, as headSelectedSeriesIndexReader is only expected to be used during compaction.
256		return index.Intersect(
257			index.NewListPostings(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef),
258			h.head.postings.PostingsForLabelMatching(ctx, name, match),
259		)
260	}
261	
262	func (h *headSelectedSeriesIndexReader) PostingsForAllLabelValues(ctx context.Context, name string) index.Postings {
263		// This is not expected to be used, as headSelectedSeriesIndexReader is only expected to be used during compaction.
264		return index.Intersect(
265			index.NewListPostings(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef),
266			h.head.postings.PostingsForAllLabelValues(ctx, name),
267		)
268	}

units.headline: New benchmark helper builds a head with N series of samples
units.summary: Test-only helper that opens a DB with compactions disabled and appends totalSeries series, committing in batches of 10k. It cannot affect production code.
units.reason: New test helper in a _test.go file; no production effect.

units.headline: Benchmark CompactSelectedSeries across six selection fractions
units.summary: New benchmark that rebuilds the DB on every iteration, with the timer stopped during setup, and times CompactSelectedSeries for a fraction of 100k series. The comment's claim that evicted series can't be reused is accurate, because eviction is destructive. Test-only.
units.reason: New benchmark only; cannot change runtime behavior.

units.headline: New public API that compacts given series into blocks and evicts them
units.summary: Adds an exported DB method. It drops series with OOO data, writes per-chunk-range blocks tagged with the selected-series hint through the shared compactHeadViewLocked, and evicts the selected series from the head under an append-ID watermark. HeadMinTime stays put. It holds cmtx and records triggered/failed/duration metrics.

issues.title: Refs missing from the head are logged as skipped OOO
issues.failure_scenario: The caller passes a ref that was already garbage-collected from the head. filterSeriesAndSortPostings drops it as not found, but the log still counts it under num_skipped_ooo, which overstates the OOO skips.

units.reason: New public compaction/eviction API that changes persisted blocks and head state.
focus: Caller-supplied refs are never deduplicated. Check whether a duplicate ref makes the sorted-by-labels postings emit the same series twice and fail the block write.
When isolation is disabled, the watermark guard does nothing, so a concurrent append to a selected series can be lost on eviction. Confirm callers can guarantee there are no such writes.
index.NewListPostings(seriesRefs) gets unsorted input. Check that nothing downstream depends on sortedByRef being sorted.

units.headline: Test checks the selected series are evicted with the hint, HeadMinTime unchanged
units.summary: New happy-path test. It checks that the selected non-stale series are evicted, one hinted block is written, HeadMinTime does not move, and the metrics are right. Test-only.

units.headline: Test checks nil or empty refs are a no-op
units.summary: New test that checks nil or empty input writes no block and leaves the triggered counter unchanged. Test-only.

units.headline: Test checks one hinted block per chunk range for a spanning series
units.summary: New test where one series spans two chunk ranges. It checks that two blocks are written, both carry the selected-series hint, and the series is evicted. Test-only.
